blocks.content: You are given a string in uppercase. You need to change all the characters of the string in lowercase. You'll again change the new strings (lowercase) to uppercase.
Java String provides two methods, toLowerCase() and toUpperCase(), to convert a string to lowercase and uppercase respectively.
